stlo.jev.enable: Use Jev to select entries in chats with this character
stlo.jev.keyHelp: Only NanoGPT connection keys are supported. Use a key with Billing set to Subscription only to block balance charges.
stlo.jev.help: Jev counts always-on entries first and respects all budgets. Failed recalls require retry or cancellation.
stlo.jev.inputHelp: Every Jev request sends all eligible entries from all active lorebooks with Jev enabled in this chat. More entries use more input tokens. The recall budget limits only the lore included in the reply prompt.
stlo.jev.inputHelpForCharacter: When Jev is enabled for a character, every request sends all eligible entries from all lorebooks active in the chat. More entries use more input tokens. The recall budget limits only the lore in the reply prompt.
stlo.warn.title: ⚠️ Caution
stlo.warn.body: Your World Info Insertion Strategy is not set to "Sorted Evenly". STLO requires the "Sorted Evenly" strategy to work properly. What would you like to do?
stlo.warn.stopped: Generation stopped. Please switch to "evenly" strategy for STLO to work.
stlo.error.encountered: STLO encountered an error. Disabling STLO, returning to core ST function
stlo.info.noLorebook: Create or select a World Info file first.
stlo.settings.saveFailed: Failed to save settings for ${0}. Check console for details.
stlo.settings.loadError.title: Settings Error
stlo.settings.loadError.body: Could not load settings for lorebook: ${0}
stlo.settings.saveError.title: Save Error
stlo.validation.priorityRange: Priority value must be between 1 and 5
stlo.validation.orderAdjustmentRange: Order adjustment must be between -10000 and 10000
stlo.validation.budgetPercentRange: Budget percent must be between 1 and 100
stlo.validation.fixedBudgetPositive: Fixed budget must be a positive integer
stlo.validation.formNotLoaded: Settings form not properly loaded. Please try again.
stlo.budget.title: Lorebook injection budget
stlo.budget.help: Control how much of the context or World Info budget this lorebook may use.
stlo.budget.tip: Tip: default (0) lets ST decide; Fixed with 1 effectively chokes off this lorebook.
stlo.modal.title: 📚 Lorebook Ordering for Sloths
stlo.modal.priority.title: Lorebook Priority
stlo.modal.priority.help: Higher numbers (4-5) process first. Lower numbers (1-2) process last.
stlo.modal.order.help: Fine-tune processing order within this priority level
stlo.modal.order.title: Order Adjustment
stlo.modal.order.explain: Higher values process first. Example: +250 for slight boost, -500 for lower priority.
stlo.modal.order.groupOnly.label: Group Chats Only
stlo.modal.order.groupOnly.help: Only apply order adjustment during group chats (ignored in single character chats)
stlo.modal.onlyWhenSpeaking.label: Only use when an assigned character speaks
stlo.modal.onlyWhenSpeaking.help.1: Applies only in group chats. When checked, this lorebook is used only on turns by assigned characters (none assigned means no injection). When unchecked, unassigned characters use the lorebook defaults.
stlo.modal.onlyWhenSpeaking.help.2: With no characters listed, this book is skipped in group chats.
stlo.modal.groupOverrides.title: Group Chat Overrides
stlo.modal.groupOverrides.info: If a character is selected in here, the priority settings here will override the lorebook's default setting only during that character's speaking turns in a group chat.
stlo.modal.groupOverrides.defaultPriorit: Unassigned characters use the lorebook defaults. Only applies in group chats.
stlo.modal.groupOverrides.selectPlacehol: Select characters for this priority level...
stlo.priority.label: Priority
stlo.cmd.arg.name: lorebook name (case-insensitive)
stlo.cmd.help: Open STLO Priority & Budget for a specific lorebook.
stlo.jev.recallHelp: Select relevant lore within the budgets. Failed requests require retry or cancel.
stlo.jev.excludeHelp: This book keeps native activation, including configured vector retrieval.
stlo.jev.budgetHelp: Maximum injection across Jev books. This does not limit what Jev reads.
stlo.jev.modeHelp: All: assess all eligible entries instead of ordinary vector recall for Jev books. Filtered: assess only keyword/vector hits. Other vector recall is retained.
stlo.jev.recentHelp: Reads the selected number of recent messages in full, unless a reading limit is set. Default: 20.
stlo.jev.messageLengthHelp: 0 = read the whole message. A positive limit keeps its end.
stlo.jev.loreLengthHelp: 0 = read the whole entry. A positive limit keeps its beginning and end.
stlo.jev.presetHelp: Strict: direct relevance. Balanced: default. Generous: indirect relevance too. Changing this selects the built-in prompt; saved custom prompts are selected below.
stlo.jev.promptHelp: Edit decision criteria, not the structured response format. The settings are shared across characters.
stlo.jev.missingProfile: Select a NanoGPT subscription connection profile.
stlo.jev.retryNotice: Retry the failed batch only. The RP reply has not been generated.
stlo.jev.cancelNotice: The reply has not been generated. Cancel and try again after checking your settings.
stlo.jev.validation: Check the numeric settings and prompt. Character limits must be 0 or 100–20,000.
stlo.jev.prepareCancelled: Recall preparation did not complete. The reply was cancelled.
stlo.jev.characterActivationHelp: Applies to every chat with this character and all active linked lorebooks, except books excluded from Jev.
stlo.jev.noCharacter: Open a one-to-one chat to set character-level Jev. Group chats use the book settings.
stlo.jev.unsupported: Jev requires World Info scan support.
stlo.jev.legacyBook: Use Jev for this book in group chats
stlo.jev.legacyBookHelp: Applies when using this book in a group chat.
stlo.jev.settingsError: Failed to open or save Jev settings.
stlo.jev.promptError: Could not complete the prompt action.
stlo.jev.promptNameInvalid: Enter a unique name of up to 80 characters.
stlo.jev.promptInvalidFile: Choose a compatible Jev prompt JSON file.
stlo.budget.unifiedHelp: The maximum this book can inject. When Jev is used, its relevant entries get this share first.
stlo.budget.unifiedTip: Unused capacity is shared. Always-on entries count toward the budget.
stlo.budget.protectHelp: Applies to all lorebooks. Prioritizes budget, not insertion order.
stlo.jev.inputTooLarge: One question with its shared context is too large. Reduce recent messages or explicitly set a reading limit.
stlo.modal.groupOverrides.emptyCard: Select a character or remove the empty card.
stlo.manager.title: Lorebook Ordering for Sloths
stlo.manager.filterHelp: Only changes the list of books you can add. Does not change character links.
stlo.manager.remove: Remove from editor (does not delete the lorebook)
stlo.manager.discard: Discard unsaved edits and remove this card? The lorebook is not deleted.
stlo.manager.empty: No lorebooks in this list. Enable Show all lorebooks to see other books.
stlo.manager.thresholdRange: Enter a vector threshold between 0 and 1.
stlo.manager.allAdded: All available books are already listed.
stlo.manager.linkedAdded: All linked books are already listed. Enable Show all lorebooks for other books.
stlo.jev.invalidBudget: Enter a positive whole-number injection budget.
stlo.vector.threshold.title: Vector similarity threshold
stlo.vector.threshold.help: Enter a value from 0 to 1. Leave blank to use the global setting. Different thresholds can require additional requests, time and cost.
stlo.vector.threshold.placeholder: Leave blank to use global setting
stlo.budget.recursionHelp: With recursive scanning, lore excluded from the final prompt can still have activated other lore.
stlo.jev.adaptiveHelp: Assess all entries below the threshold; above it, supplement native World Info hits with durable-memory cues, concise entries, explicit long-term/NPC records, concrete title/key matches, and recent entries with comparable source positions. Without World Info vectors or eligible hits, assess all. Coverage is experimental, not a recall guarantee. The threshold is an estimate, not an injection budget.
stlo.jev.adaptiveReason.vector-unavailab: World Info vector recall unavailable; assessed all
stlo.jev.adaptiveReason.coverage-all: Candidate coverage includes every eligible entry
stlo.jev.partialHelp: Only long structured Scene memories, with a built-in prompt and no reading limits. Jev may select a safe excerpt in the same request; uncertainty keeps the full text. Full-text budgets and native activation remain unchanged.
stlo.jev.partialSavedChars: Characters removed from final scan (not tokens)
stlo.metrics.scanExclusions: Final scan budget exclusions (book / Jev / world)
stlo.metrics.budgets: Per-book budget use (host estimate, full text)
stlo.metrics.recallBudget: Activated Jev memory: full budget tokens (host estimate)
stlo.metrics.rpTokens: Confirmed RP Jev memory: rendered individual tokens (host estimate)
stlo.metrics.units: Provider usage and host estimates are different units; cached tokens are not added again. Actual billing and unreported usage are unknown.
stlo.metrics.rpUnavailable: Final RP inclusion is unmeasured unless a compatible viewer provides evidence. Activation is not proof of injection.
stlo.metrics.provisional: Provisional final scan; actual activation not confirmed.
stlo.jev.adaptivePlanCache: Adaptive estimate cache hits / new calculations
stlo.metrics.budgetOnlyHelp: Jev is off. Only existing lore budget checks are reported.
stlo.report.title: Jev search result
stlo.report.budgetBasis: Host estimates from full text, not final RP tokens.
stlo.report.providerBasis: Provider-reported token usage; cache and estimates are in diagnostics.
stlo.report.rpPending: Activation alone does not confirm final RP inclusion.
